L0513

This arm table is followed by a default return that can be its explicit `else` arm

What

This arm table is followed by a default return that can be its explicit `else` arm

Why

The value-table form keeps all outcomes together and lets the block return its final expression

Fix

Replace the table and fallback with an explicit `else` arm

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0513: tests/ui_lint/redundant_tail_return.warn.

Warning [L0513] (redundant_tail_return): redundant arm-table fallback return (D-TAIL-RETURN1=A)

 Fix: replace the table and fallback with an explicit `else` arm
